# Table

A data table with real table semantics.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Table` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Table />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Table"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Data table with sorting, numeric alignment, loading, empty and error rows; scrolls sideways on phones.

| `sort` | `{ key: string; dir: 'asc' \| 'desc' }` | Controlled sort. |
